output.description: Assistant messages from the Responses API. There is NO `text` key on this node — reading `$json.text` always resolves undefined. For a single plain-text reply the assistant text is at `$json.output[0].content[0].text`. `output` can hold several message items and each message several content parts, so pick the index that matches the text you need.

type.description: Always `message` — simplified output keeps only message items

text.description: The assistant's reply as a plain STRING. With an Output Format of JSON Object or JSON Schema the node parses this into an object instead — see the `structured` schema variant.
